title: Coca-Cola Consolidated’s Cincinnati Connection: Refreshing Communities, Driving Impact
summary: At Coca-Cola Consolidated, we are proud to be Cincinnati’s local Coca-Cola bottler. More than 250 [...]
body_markdown:
At Coca-Cola Consolidated, we are proud to be Cincinnati’s local Coca-Cola bottler. More than 250 Teammates support our Cincinnati operation, serving nearly 5,400 local businesses throughout the region and helping keep store shelves stocked, restaurants running and community events refreshed.


Our impact extends far beyond our facility walls. In 2026, our Teammates partnered with Gleaners Food Bank to distribute 35,000 meals as part of Coca-Cola Consolidated’s America250 initiative, helping families facing food insecurity while supporting our companywide goal of providing 250,000 meals across our territory. We also believe strong communities deserve green spaces and opportunities to thrive. That’s why our Cincinnati production facility is supporting the Let’s Grow Local initiative alongside Cincinnati Parks & Recreation, helping plant trees and strengthen neighborhoods for future generations.


Inside our Cincinnati facility, innovation is helping us serve customers more efficiently and safely. Our operation utilizes 24 advanced Laser Guided Vehicles that move products throughout the warehouse and into our impressive 13-story automated “High Rise” storage system, which can hold up to 1.3 million cases of product. These investments help ensure we continue delivering the beverages people love while supporting a modern, efficient workplace.


Cincinnati is also home to some of our most exciting partnerships. Together with The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to serve as an Official Beverage Partner of the Cincinnati Reds. That partnership goes beyond the ballpark. Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammates joined the Reds Community Fund’s Community Build Day to help revitalize Winton Hills Academy, creating an improved environment for students while supporting sustainability efforts through recycling and waste collection. We’re also proud to support Cincinnati traditions. This year, we announced a[partnership with Montgomery Inn](https://www.cokeconsolidated.com/2026/07/28/coca-cola-consolidated-and-montgomery-inn-announce-new-partnership-bringing-coca-cola-products-to-both-restaurant-locations/) , bringing Coca-Cola beverages to two of the city’s most iconic restaurant locations and connecting two brands that have been part of Cincinnati memories for generations.


At Coca-Cola Consolidated, our Purpose is to honor God, serve others, pursue excellence and grow profitably. In Cincinnati, that purpose comes to life every day through our Teammates, customers, community partners and neighbors. Whether we’re packing meals, investing in new technology or cheering on the Reds, we’re committed to helping Cincinnati thrive for generations to come.
